payload.posture: Read Acts 20:13–16 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a detailed voyage itinerary explains that Paul sails past Ephesus because he hopes to reach Jerusalem by Pentecost. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
